trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: I worked for six hours when she called.
trap.right: I had been working for six hours when she called.
trap.why: Português usa o pretérito imperfeito (“trabalhava”). Para duração antes de outro fato passado use had been + -ing.

mcq.q: When she called, I **___** sleeping for hours.

fix.wrong: I had working for six hours.
fix.right: I had been working for six hours.

fix.wrong: They have been waiting when I arrived.
fix.right: They had been waiting when I arrived.

rewrite.prompt: Passado: “I have been working for six hours.” (when she called)
rewrite.answer: I had been working for six hours when she called.
